overview_description.description: IoTFlows offers AI-powered machine performance monitoring products. IoTFlows creates internet of things (IoT) hardware and network infrastructure. To send data from their sensors, machines, and processes to the cloud, businesses use the hardware and software of IoTFlows. IoTFlows actively participates in open source initiatives with the intention of assisting the developer community.

about_short_description.short_description: IoTFlows is a software firm that offers AI-powered machine performance monitoring IoT solutions.

product.name: IoTFlows Console
product.description: A cloud-based platform to connect, control, and manage fleets of IoT devices, enabling real-time data exchange and device monitoring.

product.name: Remote Connect
product.description: A service providing secure remote access to devices for control, monitoring, programming, and file transfer over the internet.

product.name: Device Management
product.description: A system to connect, monitor, and manage IoT device fleets remotely, including software updates, file management, and real-time data publishing.

product.name: Cloud Node-RED Server
product.description: A cloud-hosted Node-RED environment for building and orchestrating event-driven IoT workflows and integrating real-time data streams.

product.name: Alerts & Notifications
product.description: A system to create and send critical alerts and notifications via email, SMS, or push to designated users and channels for continuous monitoring.

product.name: Collaborative Workspace
product.description: A platform feature that supports team collaboration with role-based permissions, notifications, and shared dashboards for IoT device management.
